moments.title: Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games in Full Swing
moments.blurb: The XXIII Commonwealth Games are currently taking place in Glasgow, Scotland, from July 23 to August 2, featuring 10 sports and 6 Para sports across four venues.

angles.name: Day 3 Action
angles.copy: Day three of the Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games is underway! Who are you cheering on today? Catch all the action from gymnastics, swimming and more.

angles.name: Scottish Pride
angles.copy: Glasgow is buzzing as it hosts the Commonwealth Games! The city is alive with incredible athletes and fans from across the Commonwealth. #Glasgow2026

angles.name: Closing Ceremony Tease
angles.copy: Less than a week to go until the Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games closing ceremony on August 2nd, headlined by Simple Minds! What's been your highlight so far?

moments.title: Tour de France 2026 Reaches Climax
moments.blurb: The 113th edition of the Tour de France concludes tomorrow, July 26th, after starting in Barcelona on July 4th. Today is the penultimate Stage 20.

angles.name: Penultimate Stage
angles.copy: It's the penultimate stage of the Tour de France 2026 today! Who's going to seize the yellow jersey on this brutal Alps stage? Tune in for the drama.

angles.name: Final Stage Anticipation
angles.copy: Tomorrow, the Champs-Élysées beckons! The Tour de France 2026 wraps up with its final stage. Will Tadej Pogačar hold onto his lead?

moments.title: Wales Airshow Soars Over Swansea Bay
moments.blurb: The Wales Airshow is taking place today and tomorrow, July 25-26, over Swansea Bay, showcasing military aircraft and aerial displays.

angles.name: Airshow Action
angles.copy: Look up! The Wales Airshow is bringing incredible aerial displays to Swansea Bay today and tomorrow! Who's heading down to see the action? #WalesAirshow

angles.name: Local Buzz
angles.copy: The skies above Swansea Bay are alive with the Wales Airshow this weekend! Don't miss the chance to see some amazing aircraft in action.

moments.title: Ghosts Australia Launches Tonight

angles.name: New Comedy Alert
angles.copy: Get ready to meet some new spooky housemates! Ghosts Australia, the remake of the hit comedy, lands on BBC Three tonight at 10:30pm. Will you be watching?

angles.name: Remake Watch
angles.copy: The original UK 'Ghosts' was a smash, now it's Australia's turn! Catch the premiere of Ghosts Australia on BBC Three tonight.

moments.title: Casualty & The Staircase Tonight
moments.blurb: BBC One airs a new episode of 'Casualty' tonight at 9:10pm, while 'The Staircase' continues on ITV1 at 9:15pm.

angles.name: Saturday Night Drama
angles.copy: Your Saturday night TV is sorted! Catch a tense new Casualty on BBC One at 9:10pm, then switch over for more of The Staircase on ITV1. What's your pick?

angles.name: Ageless Performer
angles.copy: Still got the moves! Mick Jagger celebrates his 83rd birthday tomorrow. The man's an absolute powerhouse on stage! #RockAndRoll

angles.name: Who Will Win?

angles.name: Reality TV Climax

angles.name: Soap Legend Departs

moments.title: August Weather Outlook: Mixed Start, Potential Heat Later
moments.blurb: The UK is forecast for a mixed start to August with average temperatures, but a risk of heatwaves and more settled conditions is expected later in the month, especially in the south.

angles.name: August Forecast
angles.copy: Planning your August? The Met Office is forecasting a mixed start to the month, but with a chance of hotter, more settled weather later on. Keep those suncreams and brollies handy!

angles.name: Heatwave Watch
angles.copy: Could August bring another heatwave? Forecasts suggest the chance increases later in the month for parts of the UK. We'll keep you updated!

moments.title: Beautiful Days Festival Returns to Devon
moments.blurb: The independent, family-friendly Beautiful Days Festival, founded by the Levellers, is set to take place from August 21st to 23rd at Escot Park in Devon.

angles.name: Devon Festival Fun
angles.copy: Devon's beloved Beautiful Days Festival is back at Escot Park from August 21-23! Get ready for a weekend of independent music and family fun. #BeautifulDaysFestival

moments.title: Honiton Agricultural Show Nears
moments.blurb: The traditional Honiton Agricultural Show, one of Devon's largest one-day celebrations of agriculture, is scheduled for August 6th in East Devon.

angles.name: Rural Devon Tradition
angles.copy: The Honiton Agricultural Show is just around the corner on August 6th! Get ready for livestock, local produce, and a true taste of East Devon countryside. #HonitonShow

moments.title: Green Man Festival Full Lineup Revealed
moments.blurb: The sold-out Green Man Festival, featuring Mogwai, Wilco, Four Tet, and Wolf Alice, runs from August 20th to 23rd at Bannau Brycheiniog National Park in Wales.

angles.name: Welsh Festival Hot Ticket
angles.copy: Green Man Festival is sold out, but the lineup is huge! Mogwai, Wilco, Four Tet and Wolf Alice are heading to Bannau Brycheiniog National Park from August 20-23.
